newsitem.title: UK: Nursing Home buys seven properties.
newsitem.headline: Nursing Home buys seven properties.

text.p: Britain's Nursing Home Properties Plc said on Tuesday it had bought seven nursing homes for 12.61 million stg.
Nursing Home, which also announced a restructuring of its capital, said it now owned 63 nursing and residential homes and had invested more than 116 million stg since its formation in February 1995.

Nursing Home also announced the completion of a 100 million stg property securitisation, which it said would allow it to increase its portfolio of properties by a further 50 million stg to around 170 million stg.

The company, which specialises in buying and leasing back nursing and residential homes, said a related restructuring of its debt would lead to a charge of around 7 million stg against earnings and restrict the group's ability to pay dividends.
It said the payment of a dividend for the the three months to March 31 could be delayed until early August from early July.
